notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is one index line (name, county, coordinates, codes; the index's elevation of 18 has no unit, and the record's 5.5 m matches feet). It gives no build date, height, operator, status or access. The 2006 article describes two staffed Savannah-area towers (near Midway, near Ludowici) and does not mention Pooler (full-text search for 'Pooler' found no match); that does not establish whether the Pooler tower was staffed or standing. BLL and gfc codes are not defined in any source found; gfc is probably Georgia Forestry Commission, unverified. A search snippet (countyoffice.org, not fetched because it returned 403) lists a Georgia Forestry Commission Chatham unit at 836 U.S. 80, Pooler; not used, since the tower's own address is unknown. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
